title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. However, if the regularization is too strong, it can lead to high bias.

title: Effect of High Bias
text: High bias in a model indicates that the model is too simple and is not capturing the underlying patterns in the data.

title: Reducing Model Bias
text: To reduce model bias, consider using a more complex model or reducing the regularization strength.
